findings.highlight: I don’t know the magus behind it
findings.evidenceJa: どこの魔術師だか知らない
findings.governingReading: she does not know what magus it is or where the magus comes from
findings.explanation: mirror moon assumes a magus is directly behind the shadow rather than leaving the suspected magus’s identity and origin open.

findings.evidenceJa: どこの魔術師
findings.governingReading: the unidentified magus
findings.explanation: mirror moon assigns the still-unidentified suspected magus a male gender.

findings.highlight: We don’t have much of an option
findings.evidenceJa: 余裕ないんじゃない、お互い
findings.governingReading: neither of them has the leisure to resume hostilities until the shadow is removed
findings.explanation: The mutual practical pressure sustaining the truce becomes generic lack of options.

findings.highlight: went to Tohsaka’s classroom, class 2-A, during lunchtime to go get her
findings.evidenceJa: Ａ組に行って、屋上に連れ出した
findings.governingReading: went to class A and brought Rin out to the rooftop
findings.explanation: The completed movement to the rooftop disappears, and the source’s class A is expanded to class 2-A.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺以上にキッパリしていた
findings.governingReading: Rin’s answer was even more decisive than Shirou’s proposal
findings.explanation: Rin’s forceful certainty becomes simplicity.

findings.evidenceJa: 手分けして捜す
findings.governingReading: split up to search
findings.explanation: A concrete alternative search method becomes unspecified separate action.

findings.highlight: any place that you or Saber think is strange
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師として怪しいと思ったところ
findings.governingReading: places Shirou finds suspicious from a magus’s perspective
findings.explanation: The technical viewpoint guiding Shirou’s investigation disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 徹底的に調べること
findings.governingReading: investigate the suspicious locations thoroughly
findings.explanation: Rin’s demand for exhaustive investigation is weakened.

findings.highlight: Zouken was more terrified than any of us
findings.evidenceJa: 臓硯もあの影を恐がってた
findings.governingReading: Zouken also appeared afraid of the shadow
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a comparison making Zouken more frightened than every ally.

findings.highlight: making a non-magus like Shinji into a Master
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二をけしかけてマスターにしたり
findings.governingReading: inciting non-magus Shinji and making him a Master
findings.explanation: Zouken’s active provocation of Shinji disappears.

findings.highlight: don’t fight and just investigate it
findings.evidenceJa: 偵察にとどめておいて
findings.governingReading: limit the encounter to reconnaissance
findings.explanation: mirror moon exposes overlapping alternative wording and replaces reconnaissance with generic investigation.

findings.evidenceJa: アレと戦う
findings.governingReading: fight the shadow
findings.explanation: mirror moon strengthens future combat into an explicit attempt to kill.

findings.evidenceJa: 足場を固めてから
findings.governingReading: only after strengthening their footing or operational position
findings.explanation: A concrete strategic requirement becomes generic preparation.

findings.evidenceJa: 間桐の魔術
findings.governingReading: Matou Magecraft
findings.explanation: The setting-specific technical tradition becomes generic magic.

findings.evidenceJa: 昨日ので計れた
findings.governingReading: she measured Zouken’s ability from what happened yesterday
findings.explanation: mirror moon labels the prior event a battle.

findings.highlight: he doesn’t have a direct way to attack me
findings.evidenceJa: 直接的な攻撃手段がない
findings.governingReading: he lacks direct means of attack
findings.explanation: A general limitation becomes inability to attack Rin specifically.

findings.evidenceJa: 古臭い魔術師同士の争い
findings.governingReading: the old-fashioned dispute between magi
findings.explanation: Cultural and generational old-fashionedness becomes staleness.

findings.evidenceJa: 体で情報を稼いで
findings.governingReading: earn information through physical fieldwork
findings.explanation: The bodily legwork assigned to Shirou disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: そこまで過保護になる事はない
findings.governingReading: there is no need for him to be quite so overprotective
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recognition of his protective excess becomes generic worry.

findings.highlight: if she happened to be at the mansion
findings.evidenceJa: 何も知らない桜がいたらやりづらい
findings.governingReading: it would be difficult if Sakura, knowing nothing, were at the Matou house
findings.explanation: Rin’s stated concern about Sakura’s ignorance disappears.

findings.highlight: why are you looking so surprised
findings.evidenceJa: 意外なものを見たって目
findings.governingReading: why are you looking at her as though you have seen something impossible or unexpected
findings.explanation: The insulting quality of Shirou’s stare is weakened.

findings.highlight: like a storm, coming and going in a flash
findings.evidenceJa: ガガーンときてババーンと去っていくような、ある意味台風みたい
findings.governingReading: like a typhoon that arrives with a crash and departs with a bang
findings.explanation: The loud, comic two-stage image of Rin’s arrival and departure becomes speed.

findings.evidenceJa: 間桐の問題
findings.governingReading: resolve the Matou problem
findings.explanation: A family and conflict problem becomes an ambiguously named individual.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に甘えて
findings.governingReading: he will accept and rely on Rin’s generosity
findings.explanation: The relational concession in Shirou accepting Rin’s help disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 夜まで時間もある
findings.governingReading: there is still time until night
findings.explanation: The operational time boundary shifts from night to sunset.

findings.evidenceJa: 口元を歪める
findings.governingReading: Rin twists the corner of her mouth
findings.explanation: A physically ambiguous, ominous smile is normalized into a grin.

findings.highlight: while Shinji’s in a bad mood
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二がテンパってる間
findings.governingReading: while Shinji is panicked, overwhelmed, or losing his composure
findings.explanation: Shinji’s destabilized condition becomes ordinary irritability.

findings.evidenceJa: 肩の力が抜ける
findings.governingReading: the tension drains from his shoulders
findings.explanation: A localized release of tension becomes whole-body loss of strength.

findings.evidenceJa: 操り糸をブツンブツンと切られたぐらい
findings.governingReading: as if a marionette’s control strings were severed one after another with sharp snaps
findings.explanation: The repeated snapping sound and extreme degree of the comic comparison disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: この、また明日な遠坂
findings.governingReading: you—see you tomorrow, Rin
findings.explanation: mirror moon completes Shirou’s abandoned insult with profanity, reducing the affectionate failure to stay angry.

findings.highlight: I stalk back into the building
findings.evidenceJa: 屋上を後にする
findings.governingReading: he leaves the rooftop
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a stalking gait and fixes the next destination as inside the building.
